name: The Underbrush
premise: A noir detective who is literally underbrush: everyone steps on him mid-deduction, and he keeps the footprints as evidence.

sample.joke: She walked into my clearing. Then over it. Twice. I got her shoe size, her gait, and her opinion of my testimony, which was 'oof.' The oof corroborates.
